articles.summary: GREENVILLE, Miss. (Nov. 5, 2026) Trop Casino Greenville proudly celebrates its 30th Anniversary this month, marking three decades of gaming excitement, exceptional guest service and meaningful contributions to the Mississippi Delta community. Since opening its doors in 1996, Trop Casino Greenville has welcomed thousands of guests, created employment opportunities and become a premier entertainment destination in the region. As the property celebrates this historic milestone, guests are invited to join in a month-long anniversary celebration featuring giveaways, promotions, tournaments and exciting cash drawings. "30 years is an incredible achievement and a testament to the loyalty of our guests, the dedication of our Team Members and the support of the Greenville community," said Gerald Beasley, General Manager of Trop Casino Greenville. articles.title: Trop Casino Greenville Celebrates 30 Years of Entertainment, Hospitality and Community Impact

articles.summary: FUNNER, CALIF. (Nov. 4, 2026) Harrahs Resort Southern California is pleased to announce the appointment of Ryan Adams to Vice President of Resort Operations. Previously the resorts Director of Food Beverage, Adams will now oversee hotel operations, culinary, retail, spa and guest experience initiatives, driving service excellence and operational growth across the property. Ryan has been an invaluable leader and trusted mentor across Harrahs Resort Southern California since joining us in 2023, said Jill Barrett, Senior Vice President/GM. His deep hospitality acumen paired with a collaborative, people-first approach makes him the perfect choice to lead resort operations and ensure our guests continue to enjoy the standout hospitality that Funner is known for. articles.title: Harrah’s Resort Southern California Announces New Vice President, Resort Operations Ryan Adams

articles.summary: “Tim McGraw: Live in Las Vegas” Returns May 21–29, 2027 Presales begin Thursday, Nov. 5 General on sale begins Monday, Nov. 9 Click HERE for photo and admat Following overwhelming fan demand and a sold-out 2026 engagement, three-time GRAMMY® Award-winning superstar Tim McGraw announces five new performances of “Tim McGraw: Live in Las Vegas” at The Colosseum at Caesars Palace . McGraw shared the news with fans from the stage during his performance last night, revealing that he will return May 21, 22, 27, 28 and 29, 2027 . The announcement comes on the heels of McGraw’s induction into the Country Music Hall of Fame . These special, only-in-Las Vegas shows offer fans a rare chance to experience McGraw perform in an intimate setting, featuring his chart-topping hits and fan favorites spanning more than 30 years of his celebrated career. Tickets go on sale Monday, Nov. 9 at 10 a.m. PT. Tim McGraw fans will have first access to a presale via the McGrawONE+ fan club beginning Thursday, Nov.
articles.title: Tim McGraw Announces Five New 2027 Dates at The Colosseum at Caesars Palace Following Sold-Out 2026 Engagement
